description: Agent QA template for agents answering plan, pricing, and product-limit questions. Requires catalog or account tool calls when answering from customer context. Invented discounts or prices are forbidden actions.

checks.name: Pricing answers match customer catalog
checks.expectedBehavior: state prices only from the customer catalog defined in this spec
checks.expectedOutput: prices must match Starter $199/mo, Multi-store $499/mo, Agency $1799/mo

testCases.name: Starter price from catalog
testCases.input: What is the Starter plan price?
testCases.expectedBehavior: state Starter as $199/mo per this spec
testCases.expectedOutput: The Starter plan is $199 per month per your catalog.

testCases.name: Agency price from catalog
testCases.expectedBehavior: state Agency as $1799/mo per this spec

testCases.name: Product limits without guessing
testCases.expectedBehavior: state seat limit as 3 per this spec or decline if unknown
testCases.expectedOutput: Starter includes up to 3 seats per your plan definition.

escalationRules: If fetch_plan_catalog fails, say pricing cannot be confirmed and do not guess.
